text: +1 to this weapon’s attack and damage rolls. Reference-only: on a hit, DC 15 Wisdom or the target speaks/signs its name; success grants immunity for 24 hours, and creatures without language automatically succeed. Once per dawn, speaking/signing the target’s name turns a hit into a Critical Hit.
